whyTitle: Why does one short story deserve its own site?
why: Because in a few dozen pages, a young Tatsuki Fujimoto already shows almost everything that would later make Chainsaw Man explode: violence played as a joke, a heroine nobody can predict, and a silent pause that stabs right after the laugh {{tag:opinion}}.
And because its title is a beautiful pun: {{g:shikaku-assassin|刺客}} and {{g:shikaku-qualification|資格}} are pronounced the same, *shikaku*. An assassin, and the right to love.
